|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Boba Fett In Slave I (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-bobafettinslavei-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-bobafettinslavei022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/bobafettinslavei.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/bobafettinslavei.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Boba Fett In ''Slave I''”. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Boba Fett, who provides ability of 3. Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Slave I's power may not be reduced by opponent. Immune to Eject! Eject! and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Boba Fett In Slave I (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-bobafettinslaveiab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/bobafettinslavei.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/bobafettinslavei.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Boba Fett In ''Slave I''” → “Boba Fett In ''Slave I''” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Boba Fett In ''Slave I''”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Permanent pilot is •Boba Fett, who provides ability of 3. Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Slave I's power may not be reduced by opponent. Immune to Eject! Eject! and attrition < 5.”
